output.reason: [ev-adf2ed32df1c] says that when `cluster.inClusterEnabled: "false"` is explicitly set, existing Applications that target the in-cluster cluster go to an Unknown state and can no longer sync. New in-cluster Applications can't be created, and deleting an Application no longer deletes the resources it managed. Syncing actually breaks, so this is a failure, and workload-failure (mandatory work) fits. The remediation (clean up or migrate before upgrading, or temporarily re-enable in-cluster to clean up afterwards) and the high severity match the guide's wording.
